rules.text: High-priority or urgent patients must be scheduled before lower-priority patients.
rules.action: Schedule the most urgent patient first.

rules.text: A caregiver whose delay exceeds the acceptable threshold should hand the patient over to another available caregiver.
rules.action: Reassign the patient to another available compatible caregiver.

rules.text: When a patient cancels, the appointment is removed and the caregiver route is updated.
rules.action: Remove the appointment from the schedule.

rules.text: When a caregiver vehicle breaks down, a replacement caregiver must be assigned to guarantee continuity of care.
When critical patients compete for the same caregiver, the most urgent patient is served first.
Caregivers may exchange or replace a patient through the orchestrator when continuity requires it.
rules.action: Reassign the patient to the replacing caregiver.

rules.text: A caregiver may serve a patient only when the caregiver skill level covers the patient requirement.
Service must start inside one of the patient time windows; early arrival waits and late arrival incurs tardiness.
Working time must not exceed the rated duration plus the allowed overtime cap.
rules.action: Limit overtime and balance the workload.
